title: A sprint starts only once its research is done
goal: backlog.py new sprint also creates a goal research story (touches inside kb roots) that answers the goal's open questions with kb tools first and live docs for gaps; backlog.py start, after a start gate answered by autopilot, refuses, naming each cause, while that research story is not done or a committed story or bug has no knowledge asks or refs or any of them reads unknown, stale or conflicting; an operator-approved start keeps today's behaviour

gates.question: What research must a sprint finish before it starts?
options: a goal research story and knowledge refs on every committed item, all sufficient
gates.recommendation: a goal research story and knowledge refs on every committed item, all sufficient
gates.answer: a goal research story and knowledge refs on every committed item, all sufficient, using kb tools first
